nativeCurrency.name: KAURAX
nativeCurrency.note: Testnet gas asset. No monetary value.

l2DataFee.note: KAURAX does NOT charge users for the cost of posting their data to the underlying L2. The operator absorbs it in full. This block previously read enabled: true, which was false — nothing has ever read it. The parameters are kept as a starting point for an implementation; charging a data fee changes what every transaction costs and needs its own design, tests and migration note. See docs/UPGRADE_ROADMAP.md 3.2.

fees._implementation: Descriptive, not load-bearing. No code reads this block. The base fee actually in force comes from the --base-fee flag the execution engine is launched with (infra/scripts/devnet/start.sh); these values record what that flag is set to.

settlement.name: kaurax-devnet-l2
settlement.note: Local EVM chain standing in for the underlying rollup. Contract calls are real; the chain is local.

l1.note: Local EVM chain standing in for Ethereum. The devnet L2 does not itself post to it; see docs/data-availability.md.

faultProofs.note: Output roots are trusted. See docs/decentralization.md.

bridge.note: Devnet value chosen for iteration speed. Production requires a window measured in days.
